The use of stateless authentication has been implemented in the project. The JWT token is generated when the user logs in and is sent to the client. The client then sends the JWT token in the header of the request to the server. The server then verifies the JWT token and if the token is valid then the user is authenticated and the request is processed. If the token is invalid then the user is not authenticated and the request is not processed.
